text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year has come and Mejiro
Bright's senior
year starts today. A
pivotal time in her career is
about to
begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've come to the shrine—our first visit
of the
year—to pray for success.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the line hasn't budged in the
slightest,
has it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we'll reach the front by the
time I've
finished counting the needles
on this pine branch
again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The line isn't just moving slowly, it's at a
complete
standstill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Trainer. Haste makes waste,
as they
say...
choice_data_list: ...Should we head home? It really is about time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's be patient and wait it out. I imagine
the line
will start shuffling forward
before we know it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I can stand to wait any
longer. If we
don't leave now, the sun
will set...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It appears there are still quite a few
people in
front of us. I do have an idea,
though, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since the hall of worship is in view, why
don't we
get started with a few casual
requests from our
current position?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, it can be just like partaking in
appetizers
before the main course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just so! And I'm sure the divine will bless
us with
something for waiting as long as
we have...
choice_data_list: Like some light hors d'oeuvres... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no point just standing around
waiting for
the time to pass. We might as
well warm up with a
few prayers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready, Trainer? Let's say our
prayers
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our spirits unite as one as we happen to
make
exactly the same request:

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please let us get some good sleep while
we wait.
choice_data_list: I hope you sleep well while waiting.
Please let the line move fast.
May the gods come to us instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure whether it's divine influence
or simply
her own willpower, but Mejiro
Bright immediately
dozes off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaawn... Ah, I feel ever so refreshed... It seems the gods saw fit to grant my request.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Where are we, Trainer? It seems
we've been
spirited away by some
heavenly force...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You carried me? On your own? Why,
thank you,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...I carried it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright looks better for the quality
sleep
she got once we moved away from
all the hustle
and bustle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pleeease let this line start moving.

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Keep movin' up, will ya? Can't
you see
that empty space in front of
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a miracle. Someone somewhere must
have
heard us because the line starts
moving like
clockwork, and we find
ourselves at the front in
no time at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee... After being thrust so abruptly
into the
presence of the divine, I had no
idea what to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The harder I tried to think of something,
the
hazier my thoughts seemed to get...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, in the end, I couldn't really think
of
anything in particular...
choice_data_list: So what did you end up wishing for?
What did you end up wishing for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So I just prayed for "lots and lots of
things to go
well."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That nonchalant request is just the kind
of prayer
I'd expect from Mejiro Bright.
That said, not long
after our shrine visit,
I notice that a lot of things
seem to be
going well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Please let the gods come to us instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"This would be over in a flash if the gods
just
came to us." This is the wicked
thought running
through my mind when
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Stars above! Is that you, Bright? Come to
visit the
shrine, have you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Because if you have, I'd be happy to
guide you to
a better spot! It's far too
crowded here! Come,
come!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Greetings, Fukukitaru. That
would be
terrific, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you're hoping to pay homage to the
divine, a
mountain creek like this will do
just fine. As we all
know, the gods reside
by rivers as well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the natural world plays host to a
myriad
of divine spirits! Let's pay joyous
tribute to as
many as we can!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Praying to a great many deities while
enjoying a
stroll? Oh, how delightful!
You're quite the
goddess of good
fortune yourself, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru takes us on a tour of
all the
New Year power spots, and
having learned a
great deal, we come
away feeling as grateful for
her as for
the gods themselves.
